Implemented the Rust (stable, 2021) Cargo project under `output/` with no external dependencies.

- `inspect`: decodes `las_b64`, parses LAS 1.4 public header, VLRs/EVLRs, and point formats 0–10 into the specified structured JSON (including `extra_bytes_b64` when present).
- `render`: validates the JSON dataset, re-computes all derived header fields, encodes VLRs/EVLRs, and writes point records (including required waveform-field zeroing behavior), returning `las_b64`.

Project entry point: `output/src/main.rs`  
Build: `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`  
Run: `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <path> --output <path>`
